card.name: University press names in book citations
card.fires_on: The word "of" in "University of" and nearby spots in bibliography entries, where a university press and its location are about to be named. It also fires on punctuation and name parts in citations.

modes.label: University of
modes.description: The word "of" after "Univ" or "University" in a publisher name inside a book citation.

modes.label: Citation punctuation and names
modes.description: Punctuation or the start of a person's or publisher's name inside a reference list.

card.plain: It spots the word "of" in a university press name within a book reference, such as "University of North Carolina Press".
